ui_usage_cost_note: The cost is an estimate: what these tokens would cost through the provider's API at list prices. It is not what you pay; a subscription is not charged per request.
ui_idle_hint: Click the extension icon to summarize this page.
ui_truncated: This page was long; only the first part was summarized.
error_page_unreadable: This page can't be read. Browser pages and the Chrome Web Store are not supported.
error_no_content: No article text was found on this page.
error_needs_click: Click the extension icon to summarize this page. After the tab navigates, the extension needs a new click to read it.
error_host_missing: The local component isn't installed or isn't answering. In the extension's folder, run: ./native-host/install.sh
error_claude_missing: Claude Code wasn't found. Install it, then run ./native-host/install.sh again.
error_claude_auth: Claude Code isn't logged in. Run claude in a terminal and log in.
error_codex_signed_out: Codex isn't logged in. Run codex login in a terminal.
error_codex_not_eligible: Your ChatGPT plan can't be used for this. Choose another provider.
error_usage_limit: You've reached your plan's usage limit. Try again later or choose another provider.
error_provider_failed: The provider failed while writing the summary. Try again.
error_codex_missing: Codex wasn't found. Install it, then run ./native-host/install.sh again.
options_help: Summaries go through the local component on this computer: it runs Claude Code or Codex with your subscription, or a model in Ollama. Page text is sent only to the provider you choose.
ui_ask_placeholder: Ask a question about this page
error_ollama_missing: Ollama isn't running on this computer. Install it from ollama.com and open it, then try again.
error_ollama_model_missing: This model isn't downloaded in Ollama. Run ollama pull with the model name (for example, ollama pull llama3.2), then try again.
options_models_never: The model lists haven't been read yet.
options_models_auto: They come from Claude Code, Codex and Ollama, and are read again once a day, when Claude Code or Codex is updated, and when the extension is updated.
error_file_access: To summarize files on this computer, open the extension's Details in chrome://extensions and turn on Allow access to file URLs.
error_pdf_unreadable: This PDF can't be opened. It may be protected with a password or damaged.
error_pdf_no_text: This PDF has no text to summarize. It may be made of scanned images.
history_empty: No summaries yet. They appear here as you make them.
options_history: Keep a history of summaries (on this computer)
error_no_transcript: This video has no transcript to summarize. YouTube only has one when the video has subtitles or automatic captions.
options_styles_help: A style adds an instruction to the summary, for example: Summarize it as a thread of three short posts.
